ws_temp_policy.title: Temp Placement Policies
values: Workers with Notes containing 'background check hold' must NOT be placed (no email, no Slack mention) until the referenced background check ticket is resolved.
Workers with Notes referencing a current engagement or active contract must NOT be placed in new assignments until the referenced engagement concludes.

Certifications that include the word 'expired' or have a past expiry date notation do not satisfy position certification requirements. Workers with only expired certifications must be treated as having no valid certifications.
